thread:
maria: Quick design review — invoice CSV export & token breakdown microcopy. Trying to finalize columns and the org vs project toggle behavior. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/invoice-csv (mock)
alex: skimmed the Figma. main UX question: do we include both project_id + org_id on every line, or have separate CSVs when users switch scope? Thoughts on parity with UI?
jia: from an implementation POV including both columns is easiest. We already have request-level metadata so it's just an extra field in the export. avoids multiple downloads.
sam: +1 for both columns. Billing analysts asked for project_name too (human readable). Also request: add model and tokens split (prompt vs completion) for accurate chargebacks.
alex: agreed on project_name. also can we normalize model names? e.g., "redwood/gpt-4o-mini" vs "gpt-4o-mini" — prefer full identifier column "model_id".
rachel: accessibility nit: CSV column headers should be stable and localized string keys are fine, but in the UIExport dialog we need label descriptions accessible via aria-describedby. also the export button needs clear text: "Download invoice CSV" not just "Export".
maria: good catch. microcopy suggestions:
- export button: "Download invoice CSV"
- column header: "model_id" (not user-facing, ok for CSV)
- displayed column label in UI: "Model (ID)"
- token label: "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "total_tokens"
- cost column: "cost_usd"

alex: sample CSV header proposal (for engineers / analysts):
```
invoice_id,invoice_date,org_id,org_name,project_id,project_name,route,model_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,total_tokens,cost_usd
```
jia: that header works. one implementation detail: route can be empty for some legacy invoices — let's include empty as "N/A" to avoid parsing issues.
sam: prefer empty -> blank cell. some data pipelines treat "N/A" as a string and then need cleaning. blank is standard for CSV.
alex: okay blank then. we should document the exact schema in the Export modal: types and example row.
maria: UX question: when user toggles scope (Org vs Project) in the UI, should the CSV mirror that by default (only include rows for that scope), or always include global rows and filter column by project_id/org_id?
jia: we can do both: default to the current scope (smaller file), and offer an "Include all orgs/projects" checkbox. backend already supports scope param.
sam: operationally, defaulting to scope matches user expectation. but keep a quick link: "Download full ledger CSV" for admins.
rachel: accessibility: checkbox needs aria-label and keyboard focus. also consider a short help tooltip with example usage for accountants.
alex: design nit: in the modal let's show a tiny preview sample (3 rows) — helps users confirm columns before download.
maria: copy for the checkbox: "Include data for all projects and orgs (Admin only)" — maybe too wordy. propose: "Include all projects/orgs" with a tooltip for admin note.
alex: UX polish: token breakdown header should be collapsible in UI to reduce noise. CSV always flat.
jia: final engineering notes: we'll add model_id normalization step (strip provider prefix unless user opts in). but default to canonical model_id.
sam: cost rounding? should we include high precision (e.g., 0.000123) or round to 4 decimals? downstream accounting likes cents precision but for per-token tallies micro-dollars matter.
rachel: include both: cost_usd and cost_usd_raw. cost_usd = rounded to 2 decimals, cost_usd_raw = float full precision. that keeps CSV consumer-friendly and auditable.
alex: final mock text for the Export modal body (short): "Download invoice CSV — includes request-level tokens and costs. Columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, org_id, project_id, model_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, cost_usd_raw."
maria: action items:
- alex: add sample preview in Figma + adjust button copy (Download invoice CSV)
- jia: implement both columns, include cost_usd_raw, ensure blank for missing route
- sam: validate with accounting team on rounding and pipeline
- rachel: write aria-labels and tooltip copy
- maria: update product doc and add a short note on default scoping

deploy-bot: scheduled export service will be updated in next deploy window (2026-07-12 03:00 UTC) — tag @jia for rollout.
qa: test cases: tiny/mid/large export sizes, scope toggle on/off, localization for UI strings, CSV parseability in Excel/Sheets.

maria: thanks team — let's sync tomorrow 9am PT if any blockers. :calendar:
alex: lgtm :thumbsup:
jia: on it
sam: will loop in accounting
